loop: log --- fill a tide basin at moonrise and bottle the brine
assert basin placed | execute if block 60 -60 60 perigee:tide_basin
expectinv three bottles of full tide brine | perigee:full_brine | 3
log --- grind a full tide lens on the tidal stand
assert stand placed | execute if block 62 -60 60 perigee:tidal_stand
expectinv took the full tide lens | perigee:full_lens | 1
log --- set the lens in a phase medallion
cmd item replace entity @a weapon.offhand with perigee:full_lens
expectinv lens went into the medallion | perigee:full_lens | 0
assert dial placed | execute if block 64 -60 60 perigee:tide_dial
notes: Fills a tide basin with a water bucket at moonrise on a full moon night, waits out the condensing, bottles three Full Tide Brine with moon glass bottles, grinds a blank lens into a Full Tide Lens on the tidal stand with four pours, sets it in a phase medallion from the off hand, and places a tide dial. Every recipe is checked headless; blocks are placed and kept by the kit. Sound is off in the kit's client.
